program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))]
    row_ranges = []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows + [h]:
        if start < r:
            row_ranges.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    col_ranges = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_ranges.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    threes = set()
    twos = set()
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_ranges):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_ranges):
            vals = {grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)}
            if 3 in vals:
                threes.add(ri)
            if 2 in vals:
                twos.add(ci)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_ranges):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_ranges):
            color = 6 if ri in threes and ci in twos else 3 if ri in threes else 2 if ci in twos else 0
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
